info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Variables API

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: variableName
params.description: The name of the variable to operate on.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the operation.

items.docs: This operation retrieves a single variable, given its name and the subscription it was created at.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Creates Or Updates A Variable

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: variableName
params.description: The name of the variable to operate on.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the operation.

items.docs: This operation creates or updates a variable with the given subscription and name. Policy variables can only be used by a policy definition at the scope they are created or below.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the target subscription.

params.name: variableName
params.description: The name of the variable to operate on.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the operation.

items.docs: This operation deletes a variable, given its name and the subscription it was created in. The scope of a variable is the part of its ID preceding '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/variables/{variableName}'.

info.name: Microsoft Azure Retrieves All Variables That Are At This Subscription Level

params.name: subscriptionId

params.name: api-version
